StringData.data: 1. Arena - Combat Arena
Participate in a Combat Arena A.I. Match

1. Click Dispatch at the top. 2. Select an arena. 3. Select [A.I. Match] from the Combat Arena. 4. Click Next. 5. Click Start Match Making.
{color:#ffeb90}Tip. You can add AIs to play by yourself.{color:end}
2. Recruiting Masters
Recruiting New Masters

1. Open the Master window [P]. 2. Select a Master that can be recruited. 3. Recruit the Master with SOL.
{color:#ffeb90}Tip: You can obtain SOL when you reach a new level.{color:end}
3. Representative Master
Change the representative Master in the Master Window [P].
1. Open the Master Window (P) . 2. Select any recruited Master. 3. Click on the Representative Master button.
4. Missions - Easy
Stage completed on easy (story)
1. Press the Dispatch button up top. 2. Select a mission. 3. Select random stage on easy (story). 4. Press Next button. 5. Press Dispatch Now.
5. Equip Node
Equipping nodes in the Master Window [P].
1. Open Master Window (P) . 2. Select the Node Tab. 3. Equip Nodes by right-clicking from the Inventory.
6. Unlock a Skill
Unlock Any Master's Skills
1. Open Master Window (P). 2. Select a recruited Master. 3. Select the Skill Tab. 4. Unlock any skill with GOLD.
7. Tutorial - Titan Ruins
Start Titan Ruins Tutorial
1. Press the Dispatch button up top. 2. Select Arena. 3. Select Titan Ruins [Tutorial] mode. 4. Press Next.
8. Powering Up
Upgrading skills in the Master Window [P].
1. Open Master Window (P). 2. Select a recruited Master. 3. Select the Skill Tab. 4. Select a skill to upgrade. 5. Press the Upgrade Stage Skills button.
9. Upgrade Weapon
Change the upgrades in the Master Window [P].
1. Open Master Window (P). 2. Select Master Lua or Master Sizuka. 3. Click the Weapon Tab. 4. Select the first part. 5. Press the Upgrade Augment button.
10. Stage - Normal
Complete a stage on Normal
1. Press the Dispatch button on top. 2. Select a stage. 3. Select random stage on Normal. 4. Press Next button. 5. Press the Dispatch Now button.
10. Equipping Titles
Equip a title from the Title/Insignia Window [K].
11. Style Tokens
Manufacture Style Tokens through a Designer
1. Open the Style Token Window [,]. 2. Press the Craft button.
12. Arena - Titan Ruins
Participate in Titan Ruins

1. Click Dispatch at the top. 2. Select Titan Ruins. 3. Select the mode. {color:#e17f75}Warning! Cannot complete the mission while in the user settings mode.{color:end} 4. Click Next. 5. Click Start Match Making.
{color:#ffeb90}Tip. In Co-op vs AI, if you are not matched with any players, you will be matched with AI automatically.{color:end}
